name: zerolax
description: ZEROLAX — multilingual Telegram educational Mini App with IQ tests, entrance exams, coins and an admin dashboard.

scripts.dev: npm run migrations:generate && concurrently -n api,web,bot -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:bot"
scripts.seed: npm run migrations:generate && npm run seed -w @zerolax/api
scripts.build: npm run migrations:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @zerolax/web && npm run build -w @zerolax/api && npm run build -w @zerolax/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zerolax/shared && npm run typecheck -w @zerolax/db && npm run typecheck -w @zerolax/api && npm run typecheck -w @zerolax/bot && npm run typecheck -w @zerolax/web
scripts.test: npm run migrations:generate && npm run test -w @zerolax/api
